Foxy Animation Review

Codex drew these four animation candidates from our Foxy. Nothing here is in the game yet. Tell me which sets to keep. One thing to judge: these are softer and fluffier than the in-game Foxy below, so they may need to be matched to the game style before use.

Eating

Head into the bowl, chew, lick lips, happy sit with a heart. Reads clearly.

Bath time

In the tub with bubbles, foam on head, dripping, shake-off. The most expressive set.

Sleeping

Lie down, curl with tail, breathe, wake and stretch. Calm and clear.

Fetch: ball in mouth

Runs with the ball in the mouth, drops it, sits proudly. This is the fetch you asked for.
